name: Curried Chickpea Salad Sandwiches
summary: Mashed chickpeas with curried mayo on bread. A no-cook lunch for four.
instructions: Tip the chickpeas into a bowl and mash roughly with a fork, leaving some texture.
Stir in the mayonnaise, curry powder, lemon juice, and green onions. Season with salt and pepper.
Taste and adjust — more curry powder for spice, more mayo to loosen.
Divide between four slices of bread, top with the remaining slices, and cut in half.

substitutions.costNote: GF bread runs about $3–4 more per loaf

glutenFree.notes: The chickpea filling is naturally gluten-free — serve it on gluten-free bread or over greens.

budgetNotes: Chickpeas mashed with mayo are a cheap stand-in for chicken or egg salad.
Add diced celery or apple if you have it for crunch.
The filling keeps 3 days in the fridge.

pricingMetadata.notes: Prices verified at Ottawa No Frills, September 2026. Chickpeas $1.50/540mL can. Mayonnaise ~$0.62/100mL (4 tbsp ~60mL = $0.37, estimate). White bread ~$0.12/slice. Green onions ~$0.25/stalk. Curry powder estimated.
